title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Is the Sky Blue.
Sunlight is made of many colors mixed together.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Tiny bits of air scatter the blue light more than the other colors — so blue fills the sky we see.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
At sunset, the light travels farther… and warmer colors win the show.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: The sky isn’t painted blue.
The pictures today are a new sky world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why is the sky blue.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
